source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 2 同主题完形(学生理财/贸易游戏/网购/家庭消费决策/中国出口惠及世界/班级春游预算)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: Learning to Budget

Whenever she wanted something expensive, she would (6)____ the cost against the benefit before paying. If she ran (7)____ of money, she cut down on treats like coffee and films. Slowly, she learned that a clear plan could (8)____ her a lot of worry. By the end of the year, she had even managed to (9)____ a little money for a holiday. passages.title: Trade Helps Both Sides
